items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: George Wein took Billy Eckstein, who comes on singing ballads

ctx.x: That Charlie Parker package. Now, he went in there and, you know, that was another ridiculous thing, because George Wein took Billy Eckstein, who comes on singing ballads, I think it was in Berlin they booed Billy Eckstein off.
